articles.title: Drone strike kills dozens near Sudan displacement camp – rights group
articles.description: A drone strike blamed on Sudan’s RSF has killed 41 people near a displacement camp, while the group’s allies accuse Egypt of the attack Read Full Article at RT.com
articles.content:
The death toll from a drone strike blamed on Sudan’s paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF) near a camp for displaced people in Blue Nile state has risen to 41, according to a local rights group.
